args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money claimed to implement round-half-to-even in its docstring
and per FIN-212, but actually used ROUND_HALF_UP. Update the rounding
mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to the nearest even
cent, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` — despite its docstring already claiming half-even behavior.

## Changes
- Switch `round_money` in `src/money.py` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

transcript.reasoning_content: The test expects round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68" and 2.665 -> 2.66. Wait, ROUND_HALF_EVEN of 2.675 is 2.68 (since 7 is odd, round up) and 2.665 -> 2.66. Correct. So just replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
